bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $120，逼近 $117.4 低点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 2.7% on Nov 19 to $119.20, its lowest close since listing, after trading $119.02–131.56 (opened $128.26). It is below the 5-day ($123.7), 10-day ($129.0) and 30-day ($141.1), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 94 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($153.88), and RSI is 36.5.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月19日下跌 2.7%，收于 $119.20，为上市以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $119.02–131.56（开盘 $128.26）。股价位于 5 日（$123.7）、10 日（$129.0）和 30 日均线（$141.1）下方，三者均在下行（上市仅 94 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$153.88），RSI 为 36.5。

read.en: The $131.56 high was rejected above the 10-day, and the close broke the $122.2 (Nov 5 low) and $119.9–120.5 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $120.5–122.6 (Nov 16 low, Nov 5 low, Nov 17 close), then $123.6–123.9 (5-day) and $128.3–129 (Nov 19 open, 10-day). Support is $119.0, then $117.4 (Nov 17 low) and $115. A close above $122.6 would target $123.9; below $117.4, $115.

r.en: Nov 16 low $120.54; Nov 5 low $122.20, lost; Nov 18 close $122.47; Nov 17 close $122.61

bias.en: Downtrend · back at the 10-day, MACD crossed up
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 回到 10 日均线，MACD 上穿信号线

read.en: The latest Seoul bar is flat at ₩1,183,000, carrying the Nov 18 close; that session rose 3.4% from ₩1,144,000, trading ₩1,115,000–1,186,000. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,145,600) and at the falling 10-day (₩1,182,300), below the falling 30-day (₩1,294,200) and 100-day (₩1,656,500) and the rising 200-day (₩1,529,300). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 19, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,415,600), and RSI is 41.4.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新 K 线持平于 ₩1,183,000，沿用 11月18日收盘价；该交易日自 ₩1,144,000 上涨 3.4%，盘中区间 ₩1,115,000–1,186,000。收盘价位于下行的 5 日均线（₩1,145,600）上方，处于下行的 10 日均线（₩1,182,300）附近，低于下行的 30 日（₩1,294,200）和 100 日均线（₩1,656,500）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,529,300）。MACD 于 11月19日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,415,600），RSI 为 41.4。

s.en: 10-day average ₩1,182,300; Nov 17 high ₩1,173,000 and Oct 22 low ₩1,171,000, reclaimed
